intro.speaker: Nagh
intro.text: Apologies, Kellen. Nagh was sure he saw water this way.

intro.speaker: Kellen
intro.text: (sigh) Not to worry. We should have enough to last until we reach the city.

intro.speaker: Nagh
intro.text: A long ride, that promises to be. Nagh would have a story to forget the heat.

intro.speaker: Kellen
intro.text: But of course. Indeed, you have just reminded me of one. I saw it not in the scrolls, but in a journal, many years ago. I shall try my best to recall it in the writer's own words.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: My name is Talym Rend. This is my confession... and my warning.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Once I was one of the Empire's most cunning spies.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: But I left that life behind when my son, Novos, was stricken with a terrible madness. I sought help from the Temple, from outlander healers, and even Ashland mystics. None could help him.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: So I set out to make a bargain.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: In Morrowind it is death to commune with Sheogorath, the Daedric Prince of madness. They say he is a corner of the House of Troubles. But to save my boy, I would commune with any devil you could name.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: And so it was that I sought the fabled land of madness - - a place they call the Shivering Isles. And, gods help me, I found it.

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: A stranger! What brings you to the Fringe?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: I'm looking for Sheogorath.

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: Ooh, that's not a good idea. See, you'd have to get to New Sheoth Palace, which is on the other side of the gate, which is guarded by the Gatekeeper, who you'd have to be a madman to try to fight.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Perhaps I am a madman.

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: Ha ha, lot of those around here. If you're determined to try, check the Garden of Swords. Maybe there's a weapon there that can fight that thing. Right over there.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: I think I see it.

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: Welp, gotta run! Been real nice talking to you, don't follow me!

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Thanks for your - - hey, where's my purse?!

nodes.name: Garden of Swords
hints: Slay the Gardener's items to equip them
Slay your opponent's Animated Items to empower your creatures.

intro.speaker: Gardener
intro.text: Away you! This is my garden, you hear me? Mine!

outro.speaker: Gardener
outro.text: Stop it, stop it! You're wrecking the garden!

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: I need a weapon that can kill the Gatekeeper. Give it to me, and I'll leave.

outro.speaker: Gardener
outro.text: It pains me to harvest it but... here. I used the body of the last Gatekeeper to fertilize the ground where this axe grew. Now get out of here! And stay on the path!

battle.rulesText:
Normal:
Ai starts with a Legion Shield (creature) in left lane.
Ai starts with a Steel Scimitar (creature) in right lane.
Player starts with a Weeding the Garden on board.
Master:
Ai starts with a Gateslayer Axe (creature), a Legion Shield (creature) in left lane.
Ai starts with an Orcish Warhammer (creature) in right lane.
Player starts with a Weeding the Garden on board.

rules.text: Slay your opponent's Animated Items to empower your creatures.
Slay your opponent's Animated Items to empower your creatures.

intro.speaker: Gatekeeper
intro.text: (Challenging roar of the Gatekeeper.)

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: That thing looks tough. Not sure I'm prepared for this fight, but here goes nothing...

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: That thing's huge! Hope the Gardener was right about this axe.

outro.speaker: Cyriel
outro.text: You killed it! Fantastic! I've always wanted to see the other side of the gates! Good luck, pal. See you around!

battle.rulesText:
Opponent starts with Protector of the Fringe in play; Opponent starts with one Skeleton in each lane. Draw Gateslayer Axe and Deadly Draugr on first turn if Garden of Swords is complete.
If Garden of Swords Is Completed:
Put a Gateslayer Axe in player hand after game start.
Put a Deadly Draugr in player deck top after mulligan.
Normal:
Ai starts with a Protector of the Fringe on board.
Ai starts with a Skeleton in each lane.
Master:
Ai starts with a Protector of the Fringe on board.
Ai starts with a Skeleton in left lane.
Ai starts with a Skeleton, a Grim Champion in right lane.

rules.text: If Garden of Swords is completed: Put a Gateslayer Axe in player hand after game start. Put a Deadly Draugr in player deck top after mulligan.
If Garden of Swords is completed: Put a Gateslayer Axe in player hand after game start. Put a Deadly Draugr in player deck top after mulligan.

intro.speaker: Haskill
intro.text: I must beg your pardon, but the Lord Sheogorath will not see you. He said you were, and I quote, 'Boring, boring, boring, boo hoo, my poor son, get over yourself. No wait, get under yourself, that would be funny.'

intro.speaker: Haskill
intro.text: I suggest you try to be more entertaining. Perhaps someone needs your heroic services? The Isles are full of exciting ways for a foolhardy adventurer to amuse my lord.

nodes.name: No-Rat Camp
nodes.description: Help Cyriel escape from a giant camp.
hints: The Giant takes extra damage from skeevers.

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: Help! Help! Hey, mister, please, I need to get out of here!

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Well, look who it is. Still have my purse, thief?

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: You're not still mad about that are you? Of course you're not. Look, I'll give it back if you just help me okay? I was robbing this giant camp when these boulders fell and trapped my leg. Please, the giant could be back any minute!

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: What kind of giant?

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: The big kind! Weird one, too. They say he's afraid of rats. Probably why he calls this 'No-Rat Camp' come to think of it.

intro.speaker: Nervous Giant
intro.text: (Roars.) I smell elves in my camp! Prepare to die, elves!

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: All right, he's running off. You're safe now, thief. Thief? Oh for the love of Vehk, she's run off! Great...

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: (Sigh.) Well, on the bright side, I'm sure Sheogorath found this highly amusing.

battle.rulesText:
Opponent starts with 60 health; Opponent starts with Skeever Phobia in play; Start with 1/1 Skeever in each lane; Start with Skeever Infestation in hand.
Normal:
Ai starts with 60 health.
Ai starts with a Skeever Phobia on board.
Player starts with a Skeever in each lane.
Put a Nervous Giant in ai hand after game start.
Put a Skeever Infestation in player hand after game start.
Master:
In addition to Normal settings, ai starts with 3 Max Magicka and 80 health.

rules.text: Put a Nervous Giant in ai hand after game start.
Put a Nervous Giant in ai hand after game start.

nodes.name: Notehollow
nodes.description: Help Luzrah investigate a musical root tunnel.

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: LA dah dee dah DAH! No, no, no. Maybe it's La dee dee DAH! GAAAAH, that's not it either! Why?!

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: What's wrong?

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: Can't you hear it? The song ... playing in my head. I can't recreate it!

intro.speaker: Notehollow
intro.text: (A tune plays. It is five notes long, with the five notes being comprised of just three distinct notes.)

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: By the gods, I think I can hear it! It's coming out of that cave.

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: Yes, I've ventured inside. There are strange Grummites there that I can tell hold the notes... but I can't make them play the song! It's driving me mad not being able to hear it out loud. Please stranger, please: Make them play the song!

during.speaker: Talym
during.text: It's uncanny. It's as though something in this cave is creating the song in my mind.

during.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
during.text: That's it! You've done it! Let's get out of here.

outro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
outro.text: It's like a fog is clearing from my mind. This cave must be some kind of cruel joke of Sheogorath's, designed to draw in musical souls like us. I'm in your debt, stranger.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: Call me Talym.

outro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
outro.text: Luzrah gro-Shar, bard extraordinaire, at your service. I've been wandering the isles trying to learn their lore and songs. If you ever need knowledge, companionship, or a jaunty tune, never hesistate to call on me!

battle.rulesText:
Opponent starts with Notehollow in play.
Ai starts with a Notehollow on board.

rules.text: Recreate the song: destroy a Red Grummite, a Blue Grummite and a Yellow Grummite in this order to win. The Grummite Savage cannot be targeted (Notehollow).
Recreate the song: destroy a Red, Blue, Yellow, Yellow and Red Grummite in this order to win (can be split over multiple turns). The Grummite Savage cannot be targeted (Notehollow).

intro.speaker: Rayvat
intro.text: You there! You look like a formidable fellow. I need your help. There's a pesky knight, who's been following me around constantly! Every waking hour, it seems! I can't see him, can't ever find him -- but just I know he's there. Find him and beat him bloody for me, will you?

choice.prompt: Fight the knight, fight the mage, or tell them the truth?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You... you wouldn't happen to be following around a mage named Rayvat, are you?

intro.speaker: Tavyar
intro.text: What?! That worm? No, he's the one who's constantly following ME around! If only I could find him, I'd run him through!

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You, uh... You look a lot like him, you know that? A whole lot.

intro.speaker: Tavyar
intro.text: Nonsense! That weakling and I are nothing alike. Say, you wouldn't be willing to sort him out for me, would you? Believe me, he deserves it.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: Something tells me I'm not going to get paid for this job. (Sigh.) Well, hopefully Sheogorath at least enjoyed the show.

battle.rulesText:
Fight The Knight:Normal:
Lane: Flanking/Shadow
Fight The Knight:Master:
Lane: Flanking/Shadow
Ai starts with 4 Imperial Grunt in right lane.
Fight The Mage:
Lane: Mage Tower/Shadow
Tell The Truth:
Lane: Flanking/Mage Tower

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You... you wouldn't happen to be following around a mage named Rayvat, are you?

intro.speaker: Tavyar
intro.text: What?! That worm? No, he's the one who's constantly following ME around! If only I could find him, I'd run him through!

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You, uh... You look a lot like him, you know that? A whole lot.

intro.speaker: Tavyar
intro.text: Nonsense! That weakling and I are nothing alike. Say, you wouldn't be willing to sort him out for me, would you? Believe me, he deserves it.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: No, I promised Rayvat I'd sort you out. And a deal's a deal I suppose.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You... you wouldn't happen to be following around a mage named Rayvat, are you?

intro.speaker: Tavyar
intro.text: What?! That worm? No, he's the one who's constantly following ME around! If only I could find him, I'd run him through!

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You, uh... You look a lot like him, you know that? A whole lot.

intro.speaker: Tavyar
intro.text: Nonsense! That weakling and I are nothing alike. Say, you wouldn't be willing to sort him out for me, would you? Believe me, he deserves it.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: (Sigh.) Sure. I'll sort out 'Rayvat.' Tell you what, why don't you go around the corner and I'm sure he'll turn up.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You... you wouldn't happen to be following around a mage named Rayvat, are you?

intro.speaker: Tavyar
intro.text: What?! That worm? No, he's the one who's constantly following ME around! If only I could find him, I'd run him through!

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You, uh... You look a lot like him, you know that? A whole lot.

intro.speaker: Tavyar
intro.text: Nonsense! That weakling and I are nothing alike. Say, you wouldn't be willing to sort him out for me, would you? Believe me, he deserves it.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You do realize you're the same person, right?

intro.speaker: Tavyar/Rayvat
intro.text: What? No, that's ridiculous! Although... it would explain... Oh. Oh god. No. No, it can't be true! How dare you, you insolent, you... you pathetic coward? I'll blast you to pieces!

intro.speaker: Haskill
intro.text: Well done, sir, My lord has been much diverted by your violent and musical antics. I myself had a most raucous chuckle. Sheogorath will see you now.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Ya want me to do WHAT?! I'm the Daedric Prince of Madness! I don't make people sane! I'd have to be crazy to do that! And I am crazy. So I'll do it!

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: But here's the bargain, mortal...

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: You want me to make one person sane? You've got to bring three people around to my side of the coin. Y'understand?

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Three lovely broken minds for one boring whole one. That's fair isn't it? Given that you're desperate and I'm mean.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You have a deal.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Wonderful! I promise, It'll be the most fun you've ever had. Scratch that: It'll be the most fun I ever had, heh! But I'll have enough for both of us!.

nodes.name: Episode 2 Intro
nodes.description: Journey to Morrowind, near the city of Necrom.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Your first victim is a crusty old assassin named Zhanar. This cat has killed enough people to buy a fortress, and would ye believe, he doesn't so much as lose sleep over it? Never hears the phantom whispers of his victims? Hasn't once huddled in the darkness to escape the staring eyes of the dead? Terribly rude if ye ask me.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: There's got to be a hint of mind shattering terror in there -- and you're going to find it! Give him a good and proper haunting for me. Oh, and I brought you some friends to help! I promised them riches, cheese, and that I wouldn't dismember them.

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: Suur-prise! Luzrah's here to heeeeelp!

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: Uh...Hi. No hard feelings about that purse thing right? Of course not, you're not the type for hard feelings, right? Right.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: I told you this would be fun!

nodes.name: Fortress Catacombs
nodes.description: Infiltrate the catacombs at Zhanar's fortress.

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: Look, I found a way into the fortress catacombs.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Hmm. Sheogorath wants a "proper haunting." Maybe we can start by making a little noise.

outro.speaker: Fortress Guard
outro.text: Zhanar, did... did you hear that racket last night? It was as if the walls of the fortress were shaking, but we couldn't find anyone inside.

outro.speaker: Zhanar Tabav
outro.text: It is surely nothing. But make sure you lock the doors tonight, if it makes you feel better.

battle.rulesText:
Normal:
Player starts with a Reverberating Echoes on board.
Master:
Ai starts with a Spider Lair on board.
Ai starts with a Spider Worker in each lane.
Player starts with a Reverberating Echoes on board.

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: I've heard tales of this Zhanar -- he's killed some pretty renowned heroes. The Red Avenger, the Hero of Dawn, the list goes on. He's said to keep their weapons in his trophy room.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Is that so? Cyriel, if you can get me past the locks, I have an idea.

outro.speaker: Fortress Guard
outro.text: Zhanar! Some of the guards were found dead in the trophy room... and there was blood on the blade of the trophies! It's ... it's almost as if the ghosts of your enemies took up their weapons against us.

outro.speaker: Zhanar Tabav
outro.text: After all these years, you think these spirits would suddenly bother Zhanar? No, we have some unseen enemy. Double the guard.

outro.speaker: Cyriel
outro.text: Those guards might be a problem.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: Or an opportunity. Luzrah, tell me more about these heroes Zhanar killed.

battle.rulesText:
Normal:
Ai starts with a Trophy Case in each lane.
Master:
Ai starts with a Chieftain's Banner on board.
Ai starts with a Trophy Case in each lane.

nodes.name: Fortress Ramparts
nodes.description: Strike fear under the guise of the Hero of Dawn.

intro.speaker: Fortress Guard
intro.text: Halt! Who goes there?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: I am the fire in the darkness, the blade of the morning, the protector of the weak.

intro.speaker: Fortress Guard
intro.text: It can't be. But that helm, that axe -- It must be! It's the hero of dawn, Benor Redoran

outro.speaker: Fortress Guard
outro.text: I swear lord Zhanar, there's no question. It was the hero of dawn! Benor Redoran is reborn, and out for vengeance!

outro.speaker: Zhanar Tabav
outro.text: I will hear no more of this nonsense! This "hero" was only a man, and Zhanar killed him long ago! Zhanar fears no spirits, you hear? None!

battle.rulesText:
Normal:
Player starts with a Hero's Axe on board.
Master:
Ai starts with a Divine Fervor on board.
Player starts with a Hero's Axe on board.

nodes.name: Fortress Hallway
nodes.description: Strike fear under the guise of the Red Avenger.

intro.speaker: Fortress Guard
intro.text: What's that noise? By... by the gods. That mask -- it looks just like the one worn by the Red Avenger, Renthos Hlaalu!

outro.speaker: Fortress Guard
outro.text: Zhanar, Zhanar, I saw it with my own eyes -- I was attacked by the Red Avenger!

outro.speaker: Zhanar Tabav
outro.text: Rhenthos Hlaalu is dead. This one killed him, remember? And when Zhanar kills someone, they stay dead!

battle.rulesText:
Normal:
Player starts with a Red Avenger's Standard on board.
Master:
Ai starts with a Seht's Masterwork on board.
Player starts with a Red Avenger's Standard on board.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: We've done all we can short of showing Zhanar an actual ghost.

intro.speaker: Haskill
intro.text: Then might I suggest showing him some? My lord sent me to bring you this. It's a special soul gem able to trap and release restless spirits. Its existence is also quite offensive to them, so I dare say some should be along any minute.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: The gem is full. Let's give Zhanar a taste of what's inside.

battle.rulesText:
Normal:
AI starts with 2 Max Magicka.
Player starts with a Spirit Amulet on board.
Master:
AI starts with 3 Max Magicka.
Player starts with a Spirit Amulet on board.

nodes.name: Fortress Personal Chambers
nodes.description: Unleash Necrom's graveyard spirits on Zhanar.

intro.speaker: Zhanar Tabav
intro.text: These cowardly simpletons. Ghosts. Pfah. Perhaps spirits roam this world, but if they were vengeful, would they not have haunted Zhanar long ago? Or the tyrants and monsters of history far worse than Zhanar?

intro.speaker: Zhanar Tabav
intro.text: No. Death frees one of mortal concerns. Of vengeance, anger, and guilt. Zhanar has freed many, and someday... He will be freed in turn.

intro.speaker: Zhanar Tabav
intro.text: (A creaking floorboard, the moan of a ghost.) What is that? Who's there? No. No, it can't be! It cannot be!

during.speaker: Zhanar Tabav
during.text: Come back here you cowards! That's not a real ghost! It... it can't be!

during.speaker: Zhanar Tabav
during.text: Cravens, all of you! Zhanar fears no mindless spirits!

during.speaker: Zhanar Tabav
during.text: It is true. After all these years, they have come for Zhanar! They wish to torment this one for all eternity! I must flee!

battle.rulesText:
Normal:
Ai starts with 4 Max Magicka.
Ai starts with a Thieves Guild Recruit in each lane.
Player starts with a Haunted Amulet on board.
Master:
Ai starts with 4 Max Magicka.
Ai starts with a Elusive Schemer in each lane.
Player starts with a Haunted Amulet on board.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Zhanar Fled into the night, but there was no escape. Seeing our ghosts had broken the assassin, who would live out his days in fear of his long-dead victims. I almost pitied the old killer, but I was one step closer to curing Novos.

nodes.name: Episode 3 Intro
nodes.description: Journey to Morrowind near Telvanni territory.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Good work, mortal! I haven't laughed that hard since I made king Euryl marry a cabbage! Don't worry, it was a really pretty cabbage.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Your next nut to crack is one Baron Navir. Spoiled, arrogant little mortal, who's had everything handed to him -- money, power, fishsticks, several large rocks, you name it. But I think he craves even more.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Play on his ego. Play on his imagination. Play on his drums, I hear he hates that. Scramble his brains up good, and you'll be one step closer to curing your pathetic kid.

intro.speaker: Baron Navir
intro.text: What do you want, peasant? I've a busy day of lounging about ahead of me.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: My lord, I have made pilgrimage to bear witness to your mystical powers. For lo, I have seen the stars that you are the prince of prophecy.

intro.speaker: Baron Navir
intro.text: What nonsence is this? I have land, title, and wealth, but mystic powers? I'm no mage. Go bother the Telvanni.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: The Telvanni's might comes from books my lord. Yours is far greater. See for yourself. Make three decrees and watch as they come true.

intro.speaker: Baron Navir
intro.text: Ha! What foolishness! Very well. I decree that the Kwama in my mines shall begin laying eggs of gold. That my rival Meliel's lands shall be ravaged by his own peaceful netches. And that... oh, let's say that there is a terrible blizzard in this summer heat. There, is that enough nonsense for you, peasant?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: We shall see, my lord. We shall see.

nodes.name: Kwama Mine
nodes.description: Paint Kwama eggs golden to trick Baron Navir.

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: How are we supposed to make these Kwama lay golden eggs?

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: Oh, that's easy. Did I ever tell you I used to be a painter?

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: My lord, see what was found at your egg mine this morning.

outro.speaker: Baron Navir
outro.text: What? Golden eggs? That's impossible, but... if Meliel found out, he might raid my lands. Tell no one about this, you understand?

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: Of course, my lord.

battle.rulesText:
Put a Paint Bucket in Player hand after game start.
In Normal mode, the Giant Kwama that hatch from a Kwama Egg are 4/4. In Master mode their power and defense are increased to 8/8.

rules.text: The Giant Kwama that hatch from a Kwama Egg are 4/4.
The Giant Kwama that hatch from a Kwama Egg are 8/8.

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: Those giant things are tame? They look like monsters.

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: Oh, netches are the gentlest creatures you'll ever meet.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Usually. My neighbor is a netch farmer. Said that when a Betty is afraid, she'll secrete an oil that drives the bulls mad. So we just need to spread some of the oil around Meliel's lands.

outro.speaker: Baron Navir
outro.text: What's this? Meliel's netches are attacking his farmers? It's just as I decreed!

battle.rulesText:
Ai starts with a Betty Netch in each lane.
Player starts with a Pheromone Collector on board.

nodes.name: Mushroom Tower
nodes.description: Use a magical amplifier to manipulate the weather.

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: What are we doing at this Telvanni mushroom tower?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Hopefully making it snow. Word is the mages here have a magical amplifier high in this tower. With it, we should be able to cast a blizzard spell over the Baron's lands.

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: And you think they'll just let us waltz in and use it?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: No... that's going to be the hard part.

outro.speaker: Baron Navir
outro.text: By... by the g-g-gods! Snow! It's actually snow! I-i-in hottest summer! Perhaps this was not my w-w-wisest wish. But still! Snow!

battle.rulesText:
Normal:
Ai starts with a Mushroom Tower on board.
Player starts with a Mushroom Tower on board.
Master:
Ai starts with a Mushroom Tower, a Mages Guild Retreat on board.
Player starts with a Mushroom Tower on board.

intro.speaker: Baron Navir
intro.text: Can it be? The blizzard, the eggs, the netches -- all just as I decreed! How is this possible?! Perhaps I do indeed have powers! Perhaps I am indeed the Prince of Prophecy!

intro.speaker: Baron Navir
intro.text: I shall go demonstrate these powers in Meliel's lands!

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: Uh Oh. We better go follow him.

nodes.name: Meliel's Garrison
nodes.description: Help Baron Navir defeat his rival, Meliel.

intro.speaker: Baron Navir
intro.text: I hearby declare these lands mine by right of conquest. Let any who would oppose me taste my mystical might!

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: I guess I'm providing the mystical might...

during.speaker: Baron Navir
during.text: None may hurt the prince of prophecy!

during.speaker: Baron Navir
during.text: Hahahaha! Behold my power.

outro.speaker: Baron Navir
outro.text: BWAHAHA! YOU SEE! That peasant spoke true! I AM the prince of prophecy! I can do ANYTHING! I know -- next I shall fly! I've always wanted to fly.

outro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
outro.text: Wait, NO!

battle.rulesText: Player starts with a Baron Navir in left lane.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: It had been almost fun deceiving the Baron, inflating his already massive ego, until he hurled himself from a cliff, believing he could fly. Luzrah was horrified, and said she would no longer do Sheogorath's bidding. But I couldn't stop. I was only one mind away from curing Novos.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: I've saved your best victim for last! It's the Imperial spymaster Porcia Loran -- oh your old boss, if I'm not mistaken. And I'm usually taken correctly. She's currently attached to an Imperial phalanx that's preparing for battle against a pesky clan of Reachmen invaders.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: No. Porcia is a good person. She doesn't deserve --

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Deserve what? A little insanity? Take it from me, insanity's more fun than popping pimples with a hammer! You really ought to try it some time.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: But the choice is yours! You can go back to your poor, crazy son and forget all of this ever happened. Little Novos will never know you could have saved him.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You know I won't do that. Just... just tell me what you want me to do.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Only what you do best, Tally-boy! Get snuggled up nice and close to your target, and then ruin them. The Reachmen are holed up in that Dwemer ruin there. I'm sure you can figure it out from here.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Oh, and I've just decided: You've got three days to do the job, or the deal's off. Chop chop!

intro.speaker: Cyriel
intro.text: So what's the plan?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Porcia's whole life is her work. So if she's trying to get intelligence from the Reachmen, so are we. And as luck would have it, I see one of their couriers coming now.

outro.speaker: Cyriel
outro.text: This letter -- if I'm reading this right, the Reachmen have created a deadly poison gas! They're going to send it into battle on the back of some of those Dwemer machines. Talym, we've got to tell the Imperials about this.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: No, our target is Porcia. We've got to make sure she fails. We'll plant false intelligence, maybe something about a false antidote. I believe I once heard about a sacred flower growing nearby...

outro.speaker: Cyriel
outro.text: You can't be serious! That entire army could die!

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: And? We don't have time to find the perfect plan -- Sheogorath saw to that with his little 24-hour whim. And I would sacrifice a hundred armies -- a thousand! -- to save my son. Do you understand me?

outro.speaker: Cyriel
outro.text: Yeah. I understand. But I won't be a part of it, no matter what Sheogorath promised or threatened. Goodbye, Talym. Here's your stupid coin purse back.

battle.rulesText: Player starts with a Kill the Messenger on board.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: If I know Porcia, she could be here any minute. I need to get in, plant the false intel, and get out before she arrives.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: Made it just in time. There goes Porcia...

battle.rulesText:
Normal:
Ai starts with a Trip Wire in each lane.
Master:
Ai starts with a Pressure Plate in each lane.

intro.speaker: Reachman
intro.text: I know I heard some traps going off over here... Look, there, an intruder.

intro.speaker: Porcia
intro.text: Too many of them to fight. Why were they on such high alert?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Nchow, they've captured her! Time to play hero, for once.

during.speaker: Porcia
during.text: Talym Rend! What are you doing here?

during.speaker: Talym
during.text: Heard you might be in trouble. Hang on, I'll get you out of here.

outro.speaker: Porcia
outro.text: I didn't think I'd ever see you again after... what happened. I'm so sorry about Novos.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: It's... it's not your fault. Now what do we know about the Reachman threat?

outro.speaker: Porcia
outro.text: I found this message inside. It says they plan to attack the Shrine of Mara, because the sacred flowers growing there represent the only cure for a poison gas their warleader has devised.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: Sound like we better get there first.

battle.rulesText: Ai starts with 2 Sparking Spider, a Porcia, Imprisoned Blademaster in left lane.

intro.speaker: Priestess of Mara
intro.text: Absolutely not. Our order has guarded this grove for generations. We will not allow its sacred flowers to be used for war.

intro.speaker: Porcia
intro.text: The Doomfang clan is coming here to kill you and burn the grove!

intro.speaker: Priestess of Mara
intro.text: Then we will die. Better that than to surrender the flowers.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: We'll have to find another way then.

intro.speaker: Porcia
intro.text: No, these people are dead either way -- and those flowers mean life for our troops.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Porcia, you don't want this on your conscience.

intro.speaker: Porcia
intro.text: For the Empire, I will bear the guilt. We attack. And may the gods forgive us.

outro.speaker: Porcia
outro.text: Divine mother, forgive me.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: You did what you have to do. Let's collect the flowers and go.

battle.rulesText:
Normal:
Lane: Monastery/Shadow
Player starts with a Blademaster Porcia on board.

Lane: Monastery/Shadow

intro.speaker: Porcia
intro.text: Our alchemists have managed to refine the flowers into a gas that, if our intelligence is accurate, should negate the poison. But we don't have much of it. We have to contain the situation.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: There's a secret passageway that will allow us to attack the ruin. I think it's the only way to move our troops in, but I'd bet they know about it.

intro.speaker: Porcia
intro.text: Then it's settled. You and I will guide the troops into the passage. My guess is that they'll wait until we've committed the bulk of our forces to release the poison. and that's when we'll deploy the antidote.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: And if the antidote doesn't work?

intro.speaker: Porcia
intro.text: My intelligence was sound. It will work. It has to.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Let's go then.

during.speaker: Porcia
during.text: They've released the poison. Quickly, use the antidote!

during.speaker: Porcia
during.text: They're reacting but... Something's wrong. No! Get down!

nodes.name: The Betrayal
nodes.description: Porcia Loran driven to insanity, and a grim discovery.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: The explosion and the gas conspired to kill most of the Reachmen, along with the Imperials. Technically, her mission was a success.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: But witnessing such a massacre, with the murder of the priests weighing so heavily on her soul, was too much for Porcia to bear.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: I hear she did not speak after that day, afraid to utter another command, or to share another secret, that might hurt someone.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: She was, in other words, a better person than I. After all, I was the true architect of the atrocity.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: I hadn't been sure the flowers would react violently with the poison... but had known they would not cure it.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Yet as I journeyed home, my guilt was a whisper, next to the expectant joy of seeing my son whole again.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Imagine then my horror, when I found my house empty. I ran to a neighbor, desperate for anyone who could tell me about my son.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: My boy, Novos. Where is he? Did he run off? Did someone take him!?

intro.speaker: Neighbor
intro.text: Talym, what are you saying? Novos is dead. He's been dead for more than a year. Don't you remember?

intro.speaker: Neighbor
intro.text: We buried him... together.

intro.speaker: Nagh
intro.text: Wait, Nagh is confused. So the boy Talym was trying to save... was dead the whole time? And Talym didn't know? But he buried him -- so he must have known! And if he knew... why do these things he did?

intro.speaker: Kellen
intro.text: These are exactly the questions Talym wanted answers to. He returned to the Shivering Isles to seek them.

nodes.name: Episode 5 Intro
nodes.description: Talym returns to the Shivering Isles.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: I don't know what trick the mad god played on me. But he will answer for it.

nodes.name: New Sheoth Palace
nodes.description: Talym denied another audience with Sheogorath.

intro.speaker: Golden Saint
intro.text: Halt! our lord does not wish to see you, Talym Rend. You are not welcome in New Sheoth.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: You think you can stop me?!

intro.speaker: Dark Seducer
intro.text: Be careful -- the madness is coming over him!

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: SHEOGORATH! I'm coming for you! I'm... no. No the doors... the doors have turned to walls. There's no way in. NO. I need answers. You OWE me answers! SHEOGORATH!

outro.speaker: Kellen
outro.text: It was at that point, wracked by despair, that Talym Rend truly began to fall into madness.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: When... when did I get here? Here's as good as anywhere, isn't it? This is his plane! He must be everywhere! And probably nowhere too! Let's check under this rock. SHEOGORATH! YOU IN THERE?!

intro.speaker: Mudcrab Merchant
intro.text: Why... why don't ya keep it down pal? Shome of ush are tryn' ta sleep.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: A ha! One of your foul creations, eh? Die, abomination!

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: Haha! your monsters are no match for me, Mad God! You hear me!

nodes.name: Darkened Grove
nodes.description: Slay the gnarl in a fit of madness.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Got to... got to remember why I', here. Where here is. Whoever I am. I'm... Vivec! No that's not right. Maybe I'm a Baron? No, I know! I'm--

intro.speaker: Gnarl
intro.text: Novos Rend?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: A talking tree! Another of Sheogorath's tricks! Die, tree!

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: That'll teach trees to mess with... whoever I am.

nodes.name: Circus of Cheerful Slaughter
nodes.description: Attack the Grummite in a fit of madness.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Why am I alive, anyway? I suppose it's easier than being dead, seeing as I'm already doing it.

intro.speaker: Grummite
intro.text: You could try the alternative.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: No, I don't think so. Not today. Not today Sheogorath!

during.speaker: Grummite Savage
during.text: (Weakly sings the song from the Notehollow mission)

during.speaker: Talym
during.text: Luzrah?! Luzrah, are you okay?!

outro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
outro.text: I'll be all right. I... saw you down by the river, fighting a crab, attacking a tree. I approached, and it was like you didn't recognize me at all. What happened to you?

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: I... didn't mean to hurt you I... my mind is so jumbled. I can't keep anything straight. Maybe I don't want to.

outro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
outro.text: Well if you do, I think I know a way to help.

battle.rulesText: Lane: Madness/Shadow

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: This won't be pleasant. I'm going to play you an ancient song of great power. It will send you inside yourself, to face your darkest fears. If you're not strong enough, you may never come out.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Do it. All I have to lose is my mind.

outro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
outro.text: You're awake! You shook horribly there for a while. But I kept playing.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: Thank you. My mind is still... clouded. But I know what I have to do; Force Sheogorath to see me, to tell me the truth about whatever he did to my mind. There must be someone or something that can compel him.

outro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
outro.text: I've heard a legend that Sheogorath keeps a powerful warrior trapped in a cave in Knifepoint Hollow. Maybe he's just torturing him, but some believe that he fears him.

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: Monsters! They must be guarding Sheogorath's prisoner. Be careful in there!?

outro.speaker: Dyus
outro.text: Ah. You're here. Yes. I knew you'd show up. Dyus of Mytheria knows most things.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: You're... not what I was expecting. I was looking for a warrior?

outro.speaker: Dyus
outro.text: No. You were looking for leverage over Sheogorath. And this old librarian can provide.

battle.rulesText: Ai starts with a Ancient Prison on board.

intro.speaker: Dyus
intro.text: Once, long ago, the one you know as Sheogorath walked the earth as Jyggalag, the Daedric Prince of Order. I was his librarian, the keeper of his endless records.

intro.speaker: Dyus
intro.text: The other daedric princes feared his power, so they conspired to transform him into that which he hated most: The essence of chaos itself.

intro.speaker: Dyus
intro.text: Sheogorath has suppressed his memories of Jyggalag, and destroyed almost all trace of him, save for two: Myself, and the Sword of Jyggalag, which is... lost to him.

intro.speaker: Dyus
intro.text: I suspect I know where the sword is. Find it, and Sheogorath will see you, Though whether to thank you or kill you, even I cannot predict.

intro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
intro.text: This is the place Dyus sent told us about. What is that thing?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Maybe some last remnant of Jyggalag? Whatever it is, it's in my way.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: There it is -- the sword! Now I can face Sheogorath.

outro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
outro.text: I get the feeling this is the sort of thing you have to do alone.

outro.speaker: Talym
outro.text: Considering I'll probably die anyway? Seems best. Thank you again Luzrah. I didn't deserve you help after...

outro.speaker: Luzrah gro-Shar
outro.text: Forget it. I owed you one. Good luck Talym.

nodes.name: The Final Battle
nodes.description: Confront Sheogorath and obtain your First memory.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: So! You're back! You've got some old sword and you think that entitles you to... what? A back rub? Some cheese?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: To a reckoning! You tricked me! Manipulated my mind! Made me think my son was alive!

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: And you're welcome! You're the one who came to me. All boo hoo, and out of yer wee mortal mind. You couldn't live with your memories then, but now, oh now y'want 'em back?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: The things you made me do.

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: That was the price, Taly-boy. The price for making you forget. So I put a wee little fib in your mind about what's-his-name to motivate ya. So what?!

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Novos. His name was Novos!

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Yeah, him! Look, you want your memories back so bad? I'm all too happy to give 'em to ya! But I don't think you'll survive it.

during.speaker: Sheogorath
during.text: Here, a trip down memory lane!

battle.rulesText: Ai starts with a Memory Wand on board.

rules.text: Sheogorath's Memory Wand banishes your creatures and sends you into a memory; the match is complete when this happens.
Sheogorath's Memory Wand banishes your creatures and sends you into a memory; the match is complete when this happens.

intro.text: The fabric of reality tied in knots, time crumbling to pieces. A day... a fateful day... from long ago...

intro.speaker: Porcia
intro.text: Talym, you're our best spy, but you're not ready to go back into the field. Go home, see your son.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: The Worm Cult killed my partner. I'm ready to take them down. Set up the training exercise, I'll prove it.

intro.speaker: Porcia
intro.text: Okay. You Win. I'll find someone to watch Novos while you're gone.

during.speaker: Sheogorath

during.speaker: Sheogorath
during.text: How rude of me -- I forgot! I promised you more memories, didn't I? Well, here you go!

intro.text: Space rips itself apart, light and darkness and both at once. Another time... another moment... from long ago...

intro.speaker: Worm Cult

outro.speaker: Worm Cult

solution: Firebolt the Worm Thrall in the left lane.
Attack your opponent with House Kinsman (3 damage).
Firebolt your House Kinsman: its Last Gasp deals 3 damage and you gain 3 health.
Now that you have more health than your opponent, play Black Worm Necromancer to summon House Kinsman from your discard pile.
Firebolt House Kinsman again for the last 3 damage.

during.speaker: Sheogorath

nodes.name: The Final Battle Pt. 4
nodes.description: Defeat Sheogorath at his own game.

intro.text: What was and what has been. A shadow, a nightmare... only a memory.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Novos. My son

intro.speaker: Sheogorath
intro.text: Oh. Very sad isn't it. So very, very sad. You know, I think it's even more fun watching your mind break the second time around. Or is it the third now?

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: No. I took that easy path once. Chose to forget, to run from what I'd done. And you used me.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Not this time. This time I live with the pain. Let's see if you can do the same!

during.speaker: Sheogorath
during.text: What is this? Who's this "Prince of Order" loser? That's not... that's not me is it?

during.speaker: Sheogorath
during.text: I can't ever have been that boring! This is making me skin crawl.

during.speaker: Sheogorath
during.text: That's not me! Stop it! Cut it out! You lose!

during.speaker: Sheogorath
during.text: Give up, go home!

during.speaker: Sheogorath
during.text: Uncle! Uncle! Father, Brother, Second Cousin! Just stop making me remember!

Use the Memory Wand on Sheogorath three times to win. After the second use the defeat screen is shown, but the match continues; after the third use the match ends.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: Unable to withstand his own terrible memories, Sheogorath relented. He restored my memories, and lifted the cloud of madness from my mind. I also made him promise to leave Luzrah and Cyriel in peace.

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: In exchange, I promised to leave the Isles forever. I returned home now to nurse my grief, and perhaps, in time, to plot my revenge on the Cult of the Worm. My warning to you, then, is this:

intro.speaker: Talym
intro.text: There will always be a devil seeking a bargain, promising to take away your pains. Do not trust them. The past may be the heaviest burden, but it is our burden to bear.

intro.speaker: Nagh
intro.text: Does Kellen not have any happy tales?

intro.speaker: Kellen
intro.text: A few. But as the story reminds us, we must remember the darkest tales as well.
